threshold_note: thr_bonf and the expected null maximum agree to within one percent at this N, so a maximum near 5.65 is the sample size and not a finding.

rule90_lag1.note: z(1) = (T-3)/sqrt(T-1), so the statistic saturates near sqrt(T); at the 2^18 used in the first run that ceiling is 512 and the registered bar of 1000 could not be met at any signal strength.

registration_defects_disclosed: Q3 set the rule90 bar at z > 1000; the statistic saturates near sqrt(n), so at the 2^18 length used in the first run the bar was unreachable. First run therefore reported INCONCLUSIVE by its own rule, which was honoured; the control is re-run here at the registered depth T rather than substituted.

Q3 cast the Sturmian word as a NEGATIVE control. It is highly structured and fires hard; it is recorded here as a positive control for structure detection. The 20 i.i.d. seeds are the negative control.
scope: A band trading period against preperiod, not a bound in one variable. Says nothing about p > T/2 at any q, does not prove P1, does not touch P2. Same argument as r30-a18-autocorrelation-excludes-period-band at larger T and L, so it supersedes those numbers rather than independently confirming them.
